findings.rationale: Correct: one file repeating a block could fill all 8 slots. Now at most one (earliest) position per file per hash, up to 8 distinct files; test 13.
Correct: visibility-prefixed use was not a boundary. Strip one pub / pub(...) prefix before the Rust boundary rules, single-line and multiline; test 14.
Correct: chain detection now uses a HashSet walk from chain starts, O(hits); unit test 16 on the chain function.
Correct: a/b now always the byte-lexicographic min/max of relative paths, decoupled from traversal idx; traversal fixed to true ascending order (stack LIFO reversal called out); tests 15 and 10 note.
